extDescription.message: Masks personal and confidential data before it reaches AI chat tools, and restores it locally in the answers.

product_short.description: Short product name in the popup header.

status_protected_detail.message: Sensitive data you send to $SITE$ is checked before it leaves the browser.

status_unsupported.description: Current tab is not a supported AI site.

status_unsupported_detail.message: Browser Guard works on ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, Perplexity, DeepSeek, Mistral and Grok.

status_paused_detail.message: Messages to $SITE$ are only monitored until then. Nothing is masked.

status_disabled_policy_detail.message: Your organization turned off masking on $SITE$. Nothing is masked there; only counts of sensitive items are recorded.

status_disabled_user_detail.message: You turned off masking on $SITE$: nothing is masked there, only counts of sensitive items are recorded. Turn it back on in Settings › Sites.

status_blocked_detail.message: Your organization does not allow $SITE$ in this browser.

status_monitoring_detail.message: Sensitive data sent to $SITE$ is counted but not masked or blocked.

mode_auto_help.message: Sensitive data is replaced with placeholders such as [EMAIL_1] before sending.

mode_confirm_help.message: You review what was found and choose to send it masked or edit your message.

mode_block_help.message: Messages that contain sensitive data are not sent.

mode_monitor_help.message: Nothing is changed or blocked; findings are only counted.

managed_short.description: Short badge label for a locked setting.

managed_explanation.message: Your organization set this and it cannot be changed here.

managed_banner.message: Some settings are managed by your organization and shown read-only.
managed_banner.description: Options page banner when any key is managed.

restore_visible_help.message: Placeholders in answers are replaced with your original data, only on this device.

restore_visible_off.message: Restoring responses is turned off in Settings.

restore_visible_off_managed.message: Your organization turned off restoring responses.

native_unavailable.message: Advanced detection is unavailable; built-in rules are active

notice_restore_on.message: Original values are shown in responses

error_background.message: Settings could not be loaded. Protection keeps running with the last known policy.

error_save.message: The change could not be saved. Please try again.

error_locked.message: This setting is managed by your organization.

error_invalid.message: That value is not allowed. Please check it and try again.

error_pause_disabled.message: Your organization does not allow pausing protection.

protection_intro.message: Choose how Browser Guard handles sensitive data in messages, pastes and files.

entities_intro.message: Turn off a type to stop detecting it on every site.

never_restore_help.message: Always stays masked, even in responses.

mask_paste_help.message: Check text as soon as you paste it into the message box.

restore_responses_help.message: Placeholders in AI answers are replaced with your data on this device only. The AI service never sees the originals.

terms_intro.message: Words that are always masked, such as project code names, client names or internal hostnames.

terms_hint.message: $MIN$–$MAX$ characters, single line. Matching ignores upper and lower case.

terms_managed_count.message: Your organization defined $COUNT$ confidential terms. They are not listed here.

literal_error_too_short.message: A term needs at least 2 characters.

literal_error_too_long.message: A term can have at most 256 characters.

literal_error_multiline.message: A term must fit on one line.

literal_error_duplicate.message: This term is already in the list.

literal_error_limit.message: The list is full (1,024 terms). Remove a term first.

sites_intro.message: Choose where Browser Guard masks your messages. On sites you turn off nothing is masked or blocked; Browser Guard only counts how often sensitive data is sent.

site_blocked_help.message: Blocked by your organization; the site does not open.

telemetry_intro.message: Connect to your organization's AIDR control plane to share protection statistics with your security team.

telemetry_not_connected.message: Not connected. Nothing leaves this browser.

telemetry_key_saved_placeholder.message: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
telemetry_key_saved_placeholder.description: Placeholder when a key is saved.

telemetry_key_hint.message: Provided by your administrator. Stored only in this browser profile.

telemetry_test_note.message: Statistics are sent in small batches about once a minute.

telemetry_error_url_invalid.message: Enter a full address such as https://aidr.example.com, without a query or credentials.

telemetry_error_url_insecure.message: Use an https:// address. Plain http:// is only allowed for localhost.

telemetry_error_key_missing.message: Enter the API key from your administrator.

telemetry_error_key_invalid.message: The API key must be 8–512 characters without spaces.

telemetry_sent_counts.message: How many items of each type were found (for example 2 emails, 1 IBAN)

telemetry_sent_site.message: Which AI service was used (for example ChatGPT)

telemetry_sent_action.message: What Browser Guard did: masked, warned, blocked or allowed

telemetry_sent_policy.message: The policy identifier and extension version

telemetry_never_body.message: your messages, files, the sensitive values themselves or the pages you visit.

about_privacy_body.message: Detection runs entirely in your browser. Original values are kept in memory for the current session only and are never written to disk or sent anywhere. If your organization connects Browser Guard to its control plane, only counts are shared, never the content itself.

about_support_body.message: For help or to report a problem, contact your IT or security team.

blocked_title.message: This AI service is blocked by your organization

blocked_body.message: Your organization's policy does not allow this AI service in this browser, so Browser Guard stopped the page from loading.

blocked_help.message: If you need it for your work, contact your IT or security team. They can review the policy or suggest an approved alternative.

blocked_footer.message: This decision was made by a policy set by your organization, not by the website.

blocked_detail_shadow_ai.message: Your organization has not approved this AI service for work, so Browser Guard stopped the page from loading.
blocked_detail_shadow_ai.description: Blocked body for a Shadow AI block.

site_custom_label.description: Popup: name used for an administrator-configured internal AI site.

section_ai_access.description: Section title (Shadow AI and internal AI sites).

ai_access_intro.message: Your organization manages which AI services can be used in this browser and on which internal AI sites Browser Guard masks your messages.

shadow_mode_off.message: Visits to AI services are not counted. Services your organization blocks do not open.

shadow_mode_monitor.message: Browser Guard counts visits to known AI services per day (the service name only, never the page address) so your organization can see which ones are used.

shadow_mode_block.message: Only AI services your organization approved open in this browser. Visits are counted per service and day (never the page address).

shadow_blocked_count.message: AI services blocked by your organization: $COUNT$

shadow_access_missing.message: Browser Guard needs your permission to access $COUNT$ AI service addresses to count visits and explain blocks. Blocks apply either way. It only learns which service a tab opened.

shadow_access_granted.message: Access granted: visit counting and block explanations are active.

access_unknown.message: The access status is unavailable right now.

custom_intro.message: Browser Guard masks your messages on these sites once you allow it to access them. Reload open tabs of a site after allowing access.

native_intro.message: Optional. The AIDR Privacy helper app, installed on this computer by your IT team, recognises names, addresses and places in free text that the built-in rules cannot. Text is checked locally over the browser's native messaging channel and never leaves this computer. Without the helper, the built-in rules keep working.

native_toggle_label.message: Use the AIDR Privacy helper app

native_toggle_help.message: Needs the permission to communicate with cooperating native applications; you are asked for it when you turn this on.

native_permission_granted.message: Permission to talk to the helper app is granted.

native_permission_missing.message: Permission to talk to the helper app has not been granted yet.

native_permission_unsupported.message: This browser cannot grant the permission from this page.

native_permission_button.description: Options: button requesting the nativeMessaging permission.

native_permission_denied.message: Permission was not granted. The built-in rules stay active.

native_status_disabled.message: Advanced detection is off; built-in rules are active
native_status_disabled.description: Options: native host not in use.
